brain_consensus.narrative: October 26 bitcoin put skew narrowed to 14.3 vol points from 21.23, with the 72,000 put marked at 73.82 implied vol against 59.52 on the 88,000 call. The pipe is put implied volatility minus call implied volatility at the strikes nearest 10 percent from spot, so a smaller positive print means downside protection still costs more than upside while the gap has compressed. Open interest on the 72,000 put is 60.6 bitcoin, against 9.8 bitcoin on the 88,000 call.
